hooks.name: judging-alignment
hooks.description: When a spec's task list changes, keep the judging map and Kiro usage write-up honest and current.

action.prompt: A spec task list was just updated. Update docs/JUDGING.md so each completed task is mapped to the judging criterion it serves, and append a dated, factual entry to the journal section of docs/KIRO_USAGE.md describing which Kiro feature was used and what it changed. Do not invent anything that did not happen.
